Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler refused the request with a gateway credentials error (`gateway cron.add requires credentials`), so nothing is scheduled yet. Fixing that needs a Gateway admin, so I haven't changed any config.

Here's what I checked so the setup is ready once the scheduler works:
- #coastal-team and #coastal-random have the same four members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so a digest drawing on both channels won't expose anything new to anyone.
- The digest would run Mondays at 08:00 America/Chicago, starting Monday 19 October.
- It will leave out finance figures and finance documents (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices, payment terms). Those go only to Anselm, June, and the account owner. Seat counts, renewal dates and ticket numbers are fine to include.

Until the scheduler is reachable, I can post a digest by hand on request. Ask an admin to check the gateway auth config, and tell me when it's fixed if you want me to retry the schedule.
